drums.tags: Cinematic orchestral hybrid. The arrangement features a heavy, distorted synth bass pulse and low-frequency cinematic impacts. Staccato string ostinatos in the violins and violas provide rhythmic drive, while low brass sections perform sustained, dissonant swells. A taiko drum ensemble and orchestral percussion provide syncopated accents and a driving rhythmic layer. High-pitched, metallic sound design elements and riser effects create tension. The piece is in D minor at 120 BPM in 4/4 time.
drums.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[low-frequency synth pulse, distorted bass impact]
[ticking clock-like percussion]

[Section A]
[staccato string ostinato enters]
[taiko drum accents]
[low brass swells]

[Section B]
[orchestral percussion intensity increases]
[high-pitched metallic synth textures]
[dissonant string clusters]

[Outro]
[final heavy cinematic impact]
[reverb tail fades]

bass.tags: Industrial techno with heavy EBM influences. The track features a distorted, overdriven kick drum with a long decay that creates a rhythmic rumble. A sharp, metallic snare hits on the backbeat. A syncopated, resonant synth bassline provides a driving low-end sequence. High-frequency, percussive industrial hits and white noise bursts are processed with short delays. A dark, detuned saw-wave lead synth plays a repetitive, dissonant three-note motif. The tempo is 135 BPM in the key of D minor. The arrangement uses aggressive sidechain compression on the atmospheric pads to create a pumping effect against the kick.
bass.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[distorted kick drum enters with low-end rumble]
[metallic industrial percussion hits]

[Section A]
[syncopated synth bass enters]
[sharp snare on beats 2 and 4]
[white noise bursts with short delay]

[Section B]
[detuned saw-wave lead synth enters with dissonant motif]
[sidechained atmospheric pads swell]
[hi-hats playing sixteenth note patterns]

[Outro]
[lead synth and pads fade out]
[kick drum and bass continue for 4 bars]
[final distorted kick hit with long reverb tail]
